jobs.title: Stadium Event Security Officer, Part-Time, Daily Pay
jobs.description:
BEST Crowd Management in Arlington, TX is seeking an Event Security Officer for AT&T Stadium. This part-time role focuses on ensuring the safety of attendees, staff, and property during high-profile events and games.

As an officer you will patrol assigned areas, monitor access points, conduct bag checks, respond to incidents, and coordinate with event staff and emergency services. The role offers flexible scheduling and opportunities for growth.
